text:
Elaine: Ping  customer asked if we can guarantee <1h maintenance for private upgrades (in-region), plus KMS/HSM key rotation with auditable handoff. Field wants options and acceptance criteria.
Michael: Two practical patterns: quick operator swap (45-60m) vs per-tenant blue/green (stretch, near-zero app downtime).
Priya: HSM rotation is the main stretch item auditors insist on signed approval & audit export, which adds time.
Sam: We can pre-provision rotated keys in customer's KMS and only do final binding during window. That reduces hands-on time to minutes. Still need a signed ok.
Elaine: Who owns the peering cutover? Customer expects us to handle if we promise <1h.
Rachel: NetOps: we'll only accept ownership if there's a tested runbook + rollback trigger and paid support. Otherwise customer must perform their network switchover.
Michael: So product proposal: expose two choices in console: "Redwood-managed cutover" (premium, we run BGP/IP swap) vs "Customer-managed" (no uplift). Include SLA blurb.
Priya: Legal will need a liability clause for managed cutovers. I'll loop them in. Also: for regulated customers, require a staging dry-run of HSM rotation and exportable audit.
Sam: OpsBot: preflight checks available -> /preflight-run <customer-id>. Suggested gates: ip-reserved, dns-resolves, kms-prestaged, operator-health ok, model-pin check, kv-cache-warm >=90%.
Elaine: Can we make the console prevent selecting managed cutover unless preflight passes? UX should block and show failing items.
Rachel: NetOps will build a small verification script and AS-path proof artifact the customer can provide. We'll publish that link in console and runbook.
Michael: Engineering needs to spec automated rollback triggers (error-rate threshold, 99p latency spike) and an emergency revert API. Also sequence-lock snapshot for model rollback.
Priya: Add acceptance criteria: staging dry-run passed, audit export present, signed approver name, rollback window agreed, and contact oncall.
Sam: OpsBot: created checklist -> private-upgrade-1718801234. OpsBot: scheduled reminder tomorrow 09:00 PT to run /preflight-run 1718801234.
Elaine: Action items: Elaine draft preflight checklist + console copy; Michael define rollback triggers + revert API; Rachel provide NetOps runbook + script; Priya own legal language + HSM criteria; Sam wire OpsBot gating.
Michael: Pricing note: there should be a configurable uplift for managed cutover and a standard SLA doc. Product to own.
Priya: Also flag that some customers will never allow Redwood to touch peering. Include a field on the order page: "Network cutover ownership: Redwood / Customer".
Elaine: Good. Let's sync Tue 10am PT after preflight run. @Michael @Priya @Rachel @Sam please confirm.
Michael: +1
Priya: +1
Sam: :thumbsup:
Rachel: On it
OpsBot: follow-up thread created: 1718801278-managed-cutover-action-items
